what_it_is.prose: NewSpace Research and Technologies (NRT) is a Bengaluru-based aerospace & defence R&D company founded in 2018 by Sameer Joshi (ex-IAF fighter pilot, CEO) and Julius Amrit (COO). India's fastest-growing A&D R&D company focused on Unmanned Aerospace Systems. Flagship product: High Altitude Pseudo-Satellite (HAPS) — solar-powered UAVs flying at 60,000-90,000 ft for extended durations (3+ months). HAPS prototype achieved 27+ hour flight at 26,000 ft (May 2024 milestone). Indian MoD signed NRT for HAPS development (Mar 2022) under Innovation for Defence Excellence (iDEX); Indian Navy contracted NRT for indigenous HAPS for maritime surveillance (Mar 2024) — full-scale HAPS with 450 kg MTOW, 35 kg payload, 3+ month endurance. NRT platforms operate from 5 km to 20 km altitude with varied endurance. Indian Army awarded $15M UAV contract to NRT (first-of-its-kind procurement). Total funding $73.2M from investors including Hda Tech Growth, Trifecta Capital, Pavestone Capital, SBI Start-Up Branch, Volrado Venture Partners.
